name: Luoshen
subtitle: Spirit of the River
description: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: A mortal woman who became goddess of the river in which she drowned, Luoshen’s position in the celestial bureaucracy has risen through the ages. Today, she is a figure of longing, representing unobtainable love, beauty striven for but never achieved. To the people of Tian, she represents hope for a better, more prosperous future—if they prove worthy in working toward it.
